MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 10

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 10
   C. 2
   D. 14

3. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 12
   C. 33
   D. 32

4. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 1
   C. 57
   D. 56

5. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 1/2
   C. 2/3
   D. 1/4

6. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 24
   C. 36
   D. 12

7. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 33
   C. 32
   D. 12

8. Solve for x: x + 9 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 8
   C. 9
   D. 16

9. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 36
   C. 18
   D. 81

10. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 24
   C. 156
   D. 48

11. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x = 5
   B. x ≥ 0 only
   C. x < 5
   D. x > 5

12. Solve for x: x + 5 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 14
   C. 9
   D. 5

13. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 4

14. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 400

15. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 25
   C. 2
   D. 10

16. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 3
   C. 41
   D. 40

17. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 169
   C. 26
   D. 170

18. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 17
   C. 8
   D. 16

19. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 49
   C. 41
   D. 43

20. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 6
   B. 1, 2, 3, 6
   C. 2, 4, 6
   D. 3, 6, 9

21. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 13
   C. 37
   D. 5

22. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 2
   C. 14
   D. 49

23. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 1
   C. 7
   D. 12

24. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 2.5
   B. 0.025
   C. 0.25
   D. 0.205

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
